reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the proposal correctly includes no redline and no counterparty comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited paragraphs (§3 use restrictions, §17(b) termination certification) contain no audit, inspection, records-examination or system-access right running against the Customer; the only examination right cited (escrow materials, p0114) runs in our favour, and p0118 is a one-time post-termination destruction certification, not a recurring audit.

Complete absence of any audit right binding Customer is at least as favourable as the preferred position (limited frequency/notice/cost, no system access), so no edit is warranted and raising it could invite an audit right.

The failed deterministic check ('audit frequency limited') is a false signal here: the regex cannot match frequency-limiting language because there is no audit clause to limit; substance supports compliance.
